messages:
amira: starting a focused canary run idea for v3.5-int4. main goal: catch subtle logit-level shifts and adversarial quant artifacts before any promote. planning a three-legged check: logit-KL, entropy-shift, and adversarial-replay.

pablo: sounds good. thresholds? we need concrete numbers for the automation.

amira: draft thresholds: KL_top10_avg > 0.10 (soft-block), entropy_increase > 0.07 (soft-block), MRR_abs_drop >= 0.018 in any 5m window -> immediate rollback. adversarial-replay discord >1.2% -> block promote.

nisha: add seqlen bucketing (<256, 256-1024, >1024) and require soft-block to persist in two windows for that bucket before pausing ramp. long-doc bucket needs larger sample.

amira: yes, seqlen-aware. also want sample-size rules: min 3k treatment requests per 30m for KL to be meaningful; smaller windows fall back to replay signals.

trent: please include tokens-per-response cost guard. if tokens increase >+15% AND fidelity drops, escalate to manual rollback.

kai: suggest a bayesian tiebreak for marginal MRR diffs: require P(delta < -0.5%) > 0.975 to auto-rollback, otherwise hold and run targeted replay. reduces flapping.

amira: good call. here's a compact ops yaml for the plan (paste into canary runner):

```yaml
name: v3.5-int4-hardened-canary
steps:
  - pct: 1
    hold: 15m
  - pct: 5
    hold: 30m
  - pct: 25
    hold: 120m
checks:
  window: 5m
  seqlen_buckets: ["<256","256-1024",">1024"]
  min_samples_per_bucket: 300
metrics:
  - name: mrr_abs_drop
    immediate_rollback: 0.018
  - name: kl_top10_avg
    soft_block: 0.10
    consecutive_windows: 2
  - name: entropy_shift
    soft_block: 0.07
    consecutive_windows: 2
  - name: adversarial_replay_discord
    block_threshold: 0.012
  - name: tokens_per_response_pct_increase
    cost_flag: 0.15
bayes_tiebreak:
  delta: 0.005
  cred_mass: 0.975
  min_samples: 2000
auto_actions:
  immediate_metrics: [mrr_abs_drop]
  soft_block_actions: [kl_top10_avg, entropy_shift]
  block_actions: [adversarial_replay_discord]
flapping_protection:
  cooldown_after_rollback: 3h
  post_rollback_hold: 6h
```

pablo: nice. ops asks to include KV prefetch success in the first-200 window; if <95% treat as critical and rollback. also expose per-bucket bayes posterior on the dashboard.

nisha: and include a small curated replay seed (2k prompts) focused on punctuation/noise mutations so we get quick attn to quant fragility. if replay shows a recurring token trimming pattern, tag model and block promote.

trent: make sure rollback button bundles: top 50 discordant prompts, KL time-series, entropy plot, bayes priors, and diagnostic logs. triage needs that link.

kai: one more: add rule that tokens_cost increase without fidelity hit triggers manual review only, not auto-rollback. we don't want false positives on cost toeing.

amira: agreed. I'll PR this into the canary-runner repo and schedule the run. deploy-bot: please queue the run when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary queued for v3.5-int4 run id r-2026040107; initial 1% traffic.

pablo: thanks. will monitor KL/entropy panels and post back if we see spikes. :thumbsup:

amira: thanks team  aiming for early detection of subtle quant regressions so we don't ship calibration drift. will post replay diffs + post-run summary here.
